Employment Type.Full-time: Prioritize candidates who are seeking stability, demonstrate a strong work ethic, and possess the dedication to handle a full workload. Focus on their long-term career goals, time management abilities, and how they maintain a sustainable work-life balance.
Employment Type.Part-time: Look for individuals who are highly organized, capable of managing their time effectively, and can make significant contributions within a limited timeframe. Explore their motivations for seeking part-time work, their availability, and their ability to balance multiple commitments.
Employment Type.Contract: Seek out candidates who are adaptable, results-oriented, and can quickly integrate into new teams and projects.  Focus on their prior contract experience, their ability to deliver within specific timeframes, and their comfort level with project-based work.
Employment Type.Temporary: Prioritize candidates who are quick learners, can handle a fast-paced environment, and are comfortable stepping into a role with minimal onboarding. Assess their flexibility, their experience with short-term assignments, and their ability to make immediate contributions.
Employment Type.Internship: Look for individuals with a strong academic foundation, a passion for the industry, and a desire to learn and grow. Assess their relevant skills, their career aspirations, and their willingness to take on new challenges and contribute to real-world projects.

Industry.Tech: Prioritize candidates with strong technical skills, a passion for innovation, and the ability to adapt to rapidly changing technologies. Evaluate their problem-solving abilities, their experience with relevant tools and technologies, and their capacity for continuous learning.
Industry.Healthcare: Look for individuals who combine empathy and compassion with strong attention to detail and a commitment to providing high-quality care. Assess their clinical experience, their understanding of healthcare regulations, and their ability to work effectively under pressure.
Industry.Finance: Seek out candidates with exceptional analytical skills, a strong attention to detail, and an unwavering commitment to ethical practices. Evaluate their experience with financial analysis, their understanding of regulatory compliance, and their ability to make sound, data-driven decisions.
Industry.Education: Prioritize individuals with a passion for teaching, a commitment to student success, and the ability to create engaging and inclusive learning environments.  Assess their communication skills, their ability to adapt to diverse learning styles, and their commitment to fostering a positive educational experience.
Industry.Retail: Look for individuals who possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, a customer-centric mindset, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Evaluate their sales aptitude, their ability to handle customer interactions effectively, and their passion for delivering exceptional service.

Role Level.Entry-level: Prioritize candidates who are eager to learn, possess a strong work ethic, and are excited to contribute to the team. Focus on their transferable skills, their willingness to take on new challenges, and their potential for growth within the company.
Role Level.Mid-level: Seek out candidates with a balance of technical expertise and developing leadership skills. Evaluate their experience in managing projects, their ability to work independently and as part of a team, and their track record of achieving results.
Role Level.Senior-level: Focus on candidates with proven leadership experience, a strategic mindset, and the ability to drive organizational growth. Assess their ability to develop a vision, inspire teams, and make high-impact decisions in complex situations.
Role Level.Executive: Prioritize individuals with exceptional leadership skills, a deep understanding of business strategy, and the ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics.  Assess their track record of success, their vision for the future, and their ability to build and motivate high-performing teams.

Department / Title.Engineering: Prioritize candidates who possess strong problem-solving abilities, a deep understanding of engineering principles, and a passion for developing innovative solutions. Assess their technical expertise, their experience with relevant tools and technologies, and their ability to work collaboratively on complex projects.
Department / Title.Sales: Seek out candidates who are persuasive communicators, relationship builders, and possess a strong drive to achieve targets. Evaluate their sales experience, their ability to understand customer needs and present compelling solutions, and their track record of exceeding expectations.
Department / Title.Marketing: Focus on individuals with a deep understanding of marketing principles, the ability to develop creative and effective campaigns, and a data-driven approach to measuring results. Assess their experience with various marketing channels, their ability to analyze data and identify trends, and their creativity in developing engaging content.
Department / Title.HR: Prioritize candidates who have a strong understanding of HR principles and best practices, excellent interpersonal and communication skills, and a passion for creating a positive and supportive work environment. Assess their experience in areas such as recruitment, employee relations, and performance management.
Department / Title.Operations: Look for individuals who are highly organized, detail-oriented, and possess a strong process improvement mindset. Evaluate their experience in optimizing workflows, implementing efficient systems, and their ability to identify and solve operational challenges.

Work Environment.Remote: Prioritize candidates who are independent, self-motivated, and possess excellent communication and time management skills. Assess their experience working remotely, their ability to stay connected and collaborate effectively with a distributed team, and their comfort level with minimal supervision.
Work Environment.On-site: Look for individuals who thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy interacting with colleagues in person, and value the benefits of working from a central location. Assess their communication style, their ability to work effectively as part of a team, and their comfort level with a structured work setting.
Work Environment.Hybrid: Seek out candidates who are adaptable, possess strong communication and time management skills, and can seamlessly transition between remote and on-site work.  Assess their ability to work independently and as part of a team, their comfort level with ambiguity, and their ability to stay organized and productive in a flexible work environment.

Company Size.Small: Prioritize candidates who are adaptable, comfortable wearing multiple hats, and thrive in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of autonomy. Assess their ability to take initiative, their comfort level with ambiguity, and their willingness to contribute across different areas of the business.
Company Size.Medium: Look for individuals who can contribute to a growing organization, collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments, and navigate a more structured environment. Assess their ability to work both independently and as part of a team, their communication skills, and their understanding of organizational dynamics.
Company Size.Large: Seek out candidates who are comfortable working within established hierarchies, contributing to specific departmental goals, and navigating complex organizational structures.  Assess their experience working with standardized processes, their communication skills within a large organization, and their understanding of corporate culture.
Company Size.Enterprise: Prioritize individuals who have experience working within highly matrixed organizations, possess strong stakeholder management skills, and can effectively navigate complex decision-making processes. Assess their experience leading large-scale projects, their ability to influence at all levels of the organization, and their understanding of global business operations.

Company Culture.Collaborative: Prioritize individuals who excel in team environments, value open communication, and are eager to contribute their ideas and expertise to group projects.  Assess their ability to work effectively with others, their willingness to both share and receive feedback, and their commitment to achieving shared goals.
Company Culture.Innovative: Seek out candidates who are creative thinkers, embrace new challenges, and are passionate about pushing boundaries and developing innovative solutions.  Assess their ability to think outside the box, their willingness to challenge the status quo, and their comfort level with taking risks.
Company Culture.Fast-paced: Look for individuals who are adaptable, thrive under pressure, and can effectively prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a dynamic environment.  Assess their ability to handle stress, their organizational skills, and their willingness to take on new challenges.
Company Culture.Traditional: Prioritize candidates who value stability, respect established processes, and excel in structured work environments with clearly defined roles and responsibilities.  Assess their ability to follow instructions, their attention to detail, and their comfort level with a hierarchical organizational structure.

Team Structure and Performance Metrics.Flat: Prioritize candidates who are independent, proactive, and comfortable taking initiative.  Assess their ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision, their problem-solving skills, and their willingness to contribute ideas and take ownership of their work.
Team Structure and Performance Metrics.Hierarchical: Look for individuals who understand and respect chain of command, are comfortable taking direction and receiving feedback from superiors, and thrive in environments with clearly defined roles and responsibilities.
Team Structure and Performance Metrics.KPI-driven: Seek out candidates who are goal-oriented, possess a strong work ethic, and are motivated by achieving measurable results. Assess their understanding of key performance indicators (KPIs), their ability to track progress and meet deadlines, and their commitment to delivering tangible outcomes.
Team Structure and Performance Metrics.OKR-driven: Prioritize individuals who are aligned with the company's overall objectives, can set ambitious yet achievable goals, and understand how their individual contributions impact the bigger picture.  Assess their experience working with Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), their ability to break down larger goals into actionable steps, and their commitment to transparency and accountability.

Education.High School: Prioritize candidates with a strong work ethic, a demonstrated willingness to learn and adapt, and a clear passion for the industry. Look for transferable skills, a commitment to personal and professional development, and the potential to grow within the company.
Education.Bachelor’s: Look for candidates who possess a strong foundation in relevant industry concepts and can apply their academic knowledge to practical situations. Evaluate their coursework, internships, and projects for evidence of critical thinking, problem-solving, and potential for future career growth.
Education.Master’s: Focus on candidates who have developed specialized knowledge and advanced skills in their field. Evaluate their research experience, analytical abilities, and critical thinking to assess their capacity to handle complex problems and contribute to innovative solutions.
Education.PhD: Prioritize individuals with a deep understanding of their area of expertise, strong research and analytical skills, and the ability to communicate complex information effectively. Assess their ability to think critically, conduct independent research, and contribute to the development of new knowledge and innovative solutions.
